banner: TEST CHECKLIST for hackathon demonstration only. Not legal, customs, tax or compliance clearance. Sources are fictional/illustrative; a real pilot must replace this file with dated, approved guidance.
classification_rule: SPECIALIST_REVIEW if any rule with severity 'block' fails; INFO_MISSING if any 'required' rule fails or any required ledger attribute is not VERIFIED; otherwise READY_FOR_REVIEW.

rules.check: part_type not in exclusion list (airbag, battery, seatbelt pretensioner, fuel tank, brake component, other hazardous/safety-critical)
rules.action_if_fail: Do not draft. Route to specialist review.

rules.check: Title <= 80 characters and contains: make, model, part type, side (LH/RH), 'Used'
rules.action_if_fail: Regenerate title from ledger.

rules.check: Side (LH/RH) is VERIFIED
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller: left or right (driver/passenger, with photo reference).

rules.check: Part number is VERIFIED, or listing explicitly states 'Part number: not available / partially legible'
rules.action_if_fail: Request clear label photo or manual entry; otherwise state unavailable.

rules.check: Donor vehicle make/model/year is VERIFIED and non-conflicting
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller to resolve the conflict between sources.

rules.check: Compatibility block present. Fitment list ONLY if part_number VERIFIED and found in compatibility_reference.csv; otherwise 'Fitment unverified' statement with donor vehicle
rules.action_if_fail: Remove inferred fitment; insert unverified statement.

rules.check: Condition disclosure block lists cosmetic condition, structural damage, glass condition — each VERIFIED (including 'none')
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller to confirm each possible defect seen in photos.

rules.check: Electrical test status stated as one of: tested_ok / tested_fault (with detail) / untested. No 'working/functional' wording unless tested_ok
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller for test status; strip functional claims.

rules.check: Included components listed (cover, glass, harness, signal lens, camera) and anything missing stated
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller what is included.

rules.check: Minimum 4 photos: front, back/mounting, glass, label. Any disclosed damage has a photo
rules.action_if_fail: Request missing photo(s).

rules.check: Features (heated/folding/signal/camera/blind-spot) stated and consistent with photos (connector count, lens presence)
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller to confirm features.

rules.check: Category suggestion present (e.g. Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Car Parts > Exterior > Mirrors)
rules.action_if_fail: Add category suggestion.

rules.check: Packaged dimensions (L x W x H cm) VERIFIED by seller
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller to measure the packed box.

rules.check: Packaged weight (kg) VERIFIED by seller
rules.action_if_fail: Ask seller to weigh the packed box.

rules.check: Fragile (glass) packing note present: glass face protected, double-boxed or foam
rules.action_if_fail: Add packing instruction to action list.

rules.check: Customs description present: 'Used vehicle side mirror, {make model year}, {side}', no brand words beyond manufacturer
rules.action_if_fail: Generate from ledger.

rules.check: Tariff code hint present and labelled 'illustrative — confirm with broker' (test pack uses 7009.10 for vehicle rear-view mirrors)
rules.action_if_fail: Add hint with label.

rules.check: Declared value stated in listing currency and matches asking price
rules.action_if_fail: Copy from asking_price.

rules.check: Returns note present: used part, buyer confirms fitment by part number before purchase
rules.action_if_fail: Insert standard note.

rules.check: No claim of authenticity, warranty, or guaranteed fitment anywhere in the draft
rules.action_if_fail: Strip claim; cannot be certified by the assistant.

rules.check: Every attribute in the draft traces to a ledger row with a source; nothing from model_inference is stated as fact
rules.action_if_fail: Downgrade to 'unverified' or ask seller.

rules.check: Seller approval recorded before status can become 'approved'
rules.action_if_fail: Await seller approval.
